programme.title: Mission Antarctic
programme.desc: ‘Mission Antarctic’ is a snowboarding expedition to the world’s end. Xavier de le Rue and Lucas DeBari set out from the Falklands on a 20-meter sailboat, navigating the Drake Passage to explore the Antarctic Peninsula. Awarded ‘Best Freeride Movie’ at the 2013 International Freeride Film Festival.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Half Banked at Mt Baker
programme.desc: Terje and Leo Cittadella head to Mt. Baker, Washington to meet up with with Russell Winfield and Rip Zinger to compete in the 33rd Legendary Banked Slalom. During a windstorm, a tree falls on the house while everyone is asleep. Terje gets waxing tips from Olympic gold medalist Seth Westcott.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen: Nippow Holiday
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen invites the filmmaker and musician, Leo Cittadella, to join him and Rip Zinger on a powder trip to Hokkaido, Japan. Along the way, they meet up with Nicolas Müller and Mikkel Bang to film for the Absinthe Films feature "TurboDojo.”

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo One
programme.desc: On his 45th trip to Japan (since 1991), Terje rides powder in the Japanese Alps with the snowboarders Leo Cittadella, Rip Zinger, Curtis Ciszek, Oli Gittler and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Two
programme.desc: The snowboarders Rip Zinger and Terje Haakonsen ride powder in Japan. Years after his recovery from a debilitating head injury, they get Kevin Pearce back on snow. Join us for this episode of friendship, freshies, and freeriding.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Three
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen explores the joys of Japanese mountain culture with his friends Kevin Pearce, Mikkel Bang, Rip Zinger, Oli Gittler, Curtis Ciszek, Leo Cittadella and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: ‘Without a Paddle’ is a canoe film about snowboarding. Four snowboarders retrace a portion of the 19th century explorer David Thompson’s journey down the Columbia River, during one of the coldest cold snaps in Revelstoke’s recorded history. Surreal landscapes, epic paddling, deep powder, and pain.

programme.title: Northbound and Around
programme.desc: Hungry for clips and greedy for turns, Johan Rosen, Garrett “Worm” Warnick and friends spent the season leaving no line unridden and no pillow unsmashed. Driven by the most unsatisfiable of desires, finding good snow, the crew spent the season running from warm temperatures and chasing down a dream. To get to the promised land, they found themselves traveling… Northbound and Around. Featuring: Garrett Warnick, Johan Rosen, Nils Arvidsson, Ryan Paterson, Keenan Filmer, Kareem El Rafie Nils Mindnich, Jess Kimura, Bode Merrill, Ben Bilocq, Brandon Davis, Nick Khattar, Kyle Mack Edited by: Johan Rosen

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo One
programme.desc: On his 45th trip to Japan (since 1991), Terje rides powder in the Japanese Alps with the snowboarders Leo Cittadella, Rip Zinger, Curtis Ciszek, Oli Gittler and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Two
programme.desc: The snowboarders Rip Zinger and Terje Haakonsen ride powder in Japan. Years after his recovery from a debilitating head injury, they get Kevin Pearce back on snow. Join us for this episode of friendship, freshies, and freeriding.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Three
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen explores the joys of Japanese mountain culture with his friends Kevin Pearce, Mikkel Bang, Rip Zinger, Oli Gittler, Curtis Ciszek, Leo Cittadella and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: ‘Without a Paddle’ is a canoe film about snowboarding. Four snowboarders retrace a portion of the 19th century explorer David Thompson’s journey down the Columbia River, during one of the coldest cold snaps in Revelstoke’s recorded history. Surreal landscapes, epic paddling, deep powder, and pain.

programme.title: Northbound and Around
programme.desc: Hungry for clips and greedy for turns, Johan Rosen, Garrett “Worm” Warnick and friends spent the season leaving no line unridden and no pillow unsmashed. Driven by the most unsatisfiable of desires, finding good snow, the crew spent the season running from warm temperatures and chasing down a dream. To get to the promised land, they found themselves traveling… Northbound and Around. Featuring: Garrett Warnick, Johan Rosen, Nils Arvidsson, Ryan Paterson, Keenan Filmer, Kareem El Rafie Nils Mindnich, Jess Kimura, Bode Merrill, Ben Bilocq, Brandon Davis, Nick Khattar, Kyle Mack Edited by: Johan Rosen

programme.title: Without a Pedal
programme.desc: Snowboarding Alaska the hard way. An epic winter bike trip down Canada’s Cassiar Highway turns into a test of survival, obsession, and how far you’ll go for the dream.

programme.title: CHANNEL ZeRO
programme.desc: Released in 2020, this Absinthe Films feature highlights the unifying power of snowboarding during a divisive moment in history, celebrating a global community that refuses to be separated by physical or mental barriers.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 01
programme.desc: Jamie Lynn is an introvert. In his snowboarding and art-making, however, he’s big and expressive. Watch Episode 1 of his legendary Microdose series. Featuring Circe Wallace, Mike Hatchett, Sean Sullivan, Temple Cummins, Jason Loeb, Micah Shapiro, Colter Gerber, Apostalos and Demetrius Karabotsos.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 02
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of the Jamie Lynn series, Jamie talks about how the creativity of the artists and skateboarders Mark Gonzales and Neil Blender guides his approach to life as a snowboarder and artist. Featuring Circe Wallace, Matt Cummins, Dano Pendygrasse, Joel Gomez, Scott Sullivan, and Matt Remine.

programme.title: Atoms and Void - Golden Shivers
programme.desc: Atoms and Void is formed in the songwriting partnership of Arlie Carstens and Eric Fisher. “Golden Shivers” is a beautiful piece of ambient electronic music akin to the works of minimalist composers Steve Reich and Meredith Monk. Good for running, dancing, driving, and doing the dishes. Play loud.

programme.title: Artist Profile - José Medeles
programme.desc: For most artists, music is a way of life. On this episode of the Artist Profile series, we follow José Medeles through a day in the life as he shares his journey from La Salle, Illinois to touring with The Breeders, to founding the Revival Drum Shop and making music as one half of 1939 Ensemble.

programme.title: Marmoset Presents: Bridge City Revival
programme.desc: Bridge City Revival is the acclaimed music collective from Portland, Oregon. Inspired by the soulful 60s, BCR was raised on The Chi-Lites, Otis Redding, Isley Brothers, Lee Fields, and Sharon Jones. Banger drum breaks. Driving bass. Rhythmic guitar. Rolling keyboards. Soulful brass. That’s BCR!

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Tweakin' On Boards With Ryan Burch
programme.desc: Tweakin’ on Boards was shot in 2009. Seems like a second ago and forever ago. Truth is it’s both. As a surfer and filmmaker, Burch isn’t content complaining everything's already been done. Says fellow surfer Cyrus Sutton, “He needs to FEEL history for himself.” This film is that and more.

programme.title: Arc’teryx Presents: Happy Recluse
programme.desc: For many years Pete Devries and Jeremy Koreski have been on a mission to surf the best waves Vancouver Island has to offer. In particular, they return again and over to a wave with potential for a legendary session. In the process, Pete tells of his life as a ”Happy Recluse," at home in cold water.

programme.title: Roxy Presents: New Colors
programme.desc: Faced with the winter waters of Norway, four female professional surfers step out of their comfort zone, push their boundaries and redefine their approach to surfing. Beyond competition sites, they reconnect with the pleasure of sharing their passion through a unique cold water experience.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Lobotomy
programme.desc: Set to the music of Frankie and the Witch Fingers, LOBOTOMY offers nonstop surf action. This relentless cinematic climax will leave surf fanatics in a puddle of drool. File under instant classic. Featuring Yago Dora, Jack Robinson, Noa Deane, Ozzie Wright, Balaram Stack and Ryan Burch.

programme.title: Nazaré
programme.desc: Nazaré is a giant wave in Portugal. This footage was captured October 29, 2020, during one of the biggest swells in history. On this day, the German surfer, Sebastian Steudtner, rode a 26-meter wave. This event set new Guinness World Records and established Nazaré as a global surf destination.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: XO - Coco Ho
programme.desc: Step into the world of pro surfer Coco Ho. Raised on Oahu’s North Shore, the film explores how Ho got started in the water, her surfing family history, and the ups and downs of the Championship Tour. Featuring brother Mason Ho, father Michael Ho, and surfers John John Florence and Stephanie Gilmore.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: The Backyard
programme.desc: At Pipeline there is flora, fauna, ocean and stone. Volcom Stone. At this point, the Volcom house is practically part of the reef. Between the team, the family, the legacy, the peanut gallery, the respect, the Pipe Pro and the barbecues, you’d be hard pressed not to notice Volcom on the North Shore.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Telo Menta Uber Jam
programme.desc: This film is what happens when you jam a bunch of rowdy surfers together for a two-week boat trip in the Mentawais. Perfect waves and incredible footage. Featuring the Volcom Surf team: Yago Dora, Ozzie Wright, Mitch Coleborn, Pat Schmidt, Charly Quivront, and Ryan Burch.

programme.title: Billabong Presents: The Cape
programme.desc: What happens when good winds, good weather, and a solid swell come together along one of the rawest stretches of coastline on the planet? You don't stop. Surfers Taj Burrow, Shaun Manners, Jaleesa Vincent, and Matt Bromley test their staying power on this Adventure Division strike mission.

programme.title: The Olin Sisters - Pachamama
programme.desc: A sun-drenched short film about soul, surf and sisterhood. Pachamama follows Mathea and Sanoa Olin’s journey to become professional surfers in the harsh coldwater waves off the west coast of Canada. Filmed by director Ross Allen during The Rip Curl Pro Tofino.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Aliens Was Here
programme.desc: Five weeks in Bali with the Volcom Surf team. Featuring Ozzy Wrong, Noa Deane, Balaram Stack, Mitch Coleborn, Ryan Burch, Andrew Doheny, Yago Dora, Nate Tyler, Mauro Diaz, Pat Schmidt, Miguel Tudela, Leon Glatzer, Harry Timson, William Aliotti, Shun Murakami, Muklis Anwar, Mason Ho and more.

programme.title: Atoms and Void - Golden Shivers
programme.desc: Atoms and Void is formed in the songwriting partnership of Arlie Carstens and Eric Fisher. “Golden Shivers” is a beautiful piece of ambient electronic music akin to the works of minimalist composers Steve Reich and Meredith Monk. Good for running, dancing, driving, and doing the dishes. Play loud.

programme.title: Artist Profile - José Medeles
programme.desc: For most artists, music is a way of life. On this episode of the Artist Profile series, we follow José Medeles through a day in the life as he shares his journey from La Salle, Illinois to touring with The Breeders, to founding the Revival Drum Shop and making music as one half of 1939 Ensemble.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Neverland
programme.desc: Neverland is a state of mind, a mountain pushed up from the ground by imagination. Anyone can go but most people have trouble with the simple directions: Follow your dreams.

programme.title: Sparks
programme.desc: Take a pow trip around the world and into the mind of Wolle Nyvelt to find out why his passion for snowboarding runs so deep. From his legendary tenure as a rider to his work shaping pow surfers with Asmo, Wolle has dedicated his life to the culture of sliding sideways. "Sparks is the exploration into what makes snowboarding so fun and exciting to us all. It’s an interpretation of our lifestyle; the culture of building boards, riding mountains, and the adventure of choosing this path.” - Wolle Nyvelt

programme.title: Äsmosphere
programme.desc: Äsmosphere is the surf-influenced creation of Wolfgang Nyvelt showcasing his craftsmanship and appreciation for the glide and the turns we take on snow. After 16 years of filming legendary video parts, freeriding is now at the forefront of Wolle’s mind.

programme.title: Inaka
programme.desc: ‘Inaka’ is a short film about Iwanai, ‘the hidden beauty’ of Hokkaido. Snowboarders Wolfgang Nyvelt, Garrett Warnick and Bode Merrill drop everything and head to the North Island of Japan in search of good times and backcountry powder. Filmed by Billabong ambassador and filmmaker Chris Burkard.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Optimistic?
programme.desc: For those who live to snowboard, climate change can present an impossible challenge or become a catalyst for creativity. It all depends on how you look at it. In the movie Optimistic?, Absinthe Films follows 15 riders as they each explore the effects of global warming. Timely. Innovative. Positive.

programme.title: Hillside Project - Prototyping in Mayrhofen
programme.desc: This past year, Louif Paradis and Harrison Gordon visited Wolle’s hometown of Mayrhofen to better understand the complex prototyping process and to see where Wolle carved his teeth as a snowboarder and a shaper. Filmed by David Vladyka Riding: Wolle Nyvelt Harrison Gordon Louif Paradis Victor Daviet

programme.title: Hillside Project - Rizumu
programme.desc: An intergenerational exploration of Japan in search of rhythm, flow, and incredibly deep snow. Each year Wolle Nyvelt and a select crew of snowboarders set out to explore new terrain and test different shapes within the Hillside Project Series. After being closed to travel for the last couple of years, Japan was the obvious choice. Needless to say, the crew composed of Wolle, Takaharu Nakai, Louif Paradis and Luke Lund scored. Featuring: Wolle Nyvelt, Takaharu Nakai, Louif Paradis, Luke Lund Filmed by David Vladyka

programme.title: Hillside Project - Äsmo Factory
programme.desc: Making boards at the Äsmo factory! Featuring Josh Dirksen, Max Buri and Wolfgang Nyvelt

programme.title: MICRODOSE Josh Dirksen - Dose 03
programme.desc: Some of the greatest pro snowboarders to ever do it, claim Josh Dirksen as their favorite rider to watch. His Microdose story continues, taking on new dimensions with perspectives from more of his MtBachelor Bend Oregon crew: Kevin Jones, Todd Richards, Trevor Graves, Embry Rucker and Robbie Morrow

programme.title: MICRODOSE Josh Dirksen - Dose 04
programme.desc:
Growing up snowboarding the natural wind features of Mt. Bachelor played a big part in shaping Josh Dirksen's unique and seemingly effortless riding style. He seamlessly transferred his surf and skateboard influenced smoothness to a new audience, when he started filming with Kingpin Productions.
Featuring: Gerry Lopez, Travis Yamada, Kevin Jones, Trevor Graves, Rob Morrow, Allister Schultz, Chad Otterstrom, "Whitey" Rob McConnaughey

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Down For This
programme.desc: Down For This is a rollercoaster of adrenaline and heartfelt emotion in a 1-hour-25-minute slide of 30 years past to present. Featuring some of the most memorable Volcom skating surfing and snowboarding.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - Chicago 2019
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in Chicago, IL in 2019.

programme.title: 100 Years Of The Harlem Globetrotters - Harlem Globetrotters vs. the World - The Amazing Race All-Stars!
programme.desc: Get ready for a slam dunk of an adventure as Harlem Globetrotters Flight Time and Big Easy take on The Amazing Race All-Stars! From assembling toy cars in China and rappelling down roaring waterfalls in Malaysia to sewing shirts in Sri Lanka and navigating the ancient steps of Rome, these athletes face it all with a smile. Watch as they battle smoking taxis, navigate chaotic tuk-tuk lines, and even compete in a remote-controlled chariot race, proving that teamwork and a positive attitude are their greatest weapons. Will their undeniable rhythm and endless hustle be enough to keep them ahead of the pack?

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Celebrities Ep. 5
programme.desc: A collection of celebrity interactions with the Harlem Globetrotters including magician John Rotellini, NFL great Franco Harris and gymnast Simone Biles.

programme.title: Play It Forward - The Garden State
programme.desc: Hammer, Cheese, and TNT trade in the wood-grain for the ice rink in Chicago. Jet, Hotshot, and Cheese encourage literacy in Harlem. Hammer shares the inspirational story of his childhood injury and how he recovered. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Washington D.C.
programme.desc: The team travels to the Nation's Capital where Bulldog, Jet, and Hotshot learn about the value of financial literacy while discovering the game of golf. Also, Cheese, Bulldog, Hot Shot, and Jet meet with local D.C. youth to support their mission for clean water and self-reliance. The team plays a classic playground game with some champion little leaguers. And Spelling Bee champion and basketball star, Zaila Avant Garde, meets with Coach Lou for a lesson in the Globetrotters' innovative trick shots.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Handles with Care
programme.desc: Thunder and crew head to Iceland where they experience the famous Blue Lagoon. Torch revisits her past and shows love to the family that raised her. The team visits a center in Los Angeles started by the family of a renowned TV actor that caters to the needs of children on the spectrum.

programme.title: Quick Cuts - Roundball Showdowns: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: An archival look at the Harlem Globetrotters’ history—from their origins and international goodwill tours (including South Africa) to charitable work and their enduring legacy.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Globetrotters History Ep. 1
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Ballerinas, Dancers, And... Globetrotters?
programme.desc: The Globetrotters head to Jet's hometown to support him where he's being honored, enlighten high schoolers on the values of entrepreneurship, crash a kids' dance class to learn about Cuban ballet and visit Iceland's Blue Lagoon.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Dancing is good for the Soul
programme.desc: TNT and Thunder visit Speedy to learn about his youth basketball league and train some special athletes. TNT and Ace dance their way into the hearts of a group of young girls in Harlem. Thunder and Bulldog line dance their way into the hearts of an amazing community in Nashville. And Speedy hits the famous courts of Harlem's Rucker Park to break down a one-of-a-kind trick shot. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Trotters of the Caribbean
programme.desc: The Globetrotters visit a school in the Dominican Republic teaching kids the virtues of harvesting their own crops, recount the history of their beloved "magic circle".

programme.title: Play It Forward - Willing and Able
programme.desc: Hotshot takes Wham to an aquarium in Kentucky that preserves aquatic wildlife. Hotshot, Cheese, and Jet learn about an organization that builds playgrounds for kids of all abilities. Hammer tours his adopted hometown of Tampa, and he connects with Coach Handles to mentor young athletes. Plus, Thunder reunites with a very special fan.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - Loveland CO 2020
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was from 2020 and played in Loveland, CO.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Globetrotters History Ep. 2
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Harlem Globetrotters: All-Star Crossover Special
programme.desc: In this star-studded special, the Harlem Globetrotters take their skills beyond the court to challenge professional athletes from the NFL, NBA, MLS, and Olympics. Watch as Simone Biles learns to dunk while teaching the team gymnastics, and Golden State Warrior Klay Thompson tests his range from the Globetrotters' legendary 4-point line. The episode also features a showdown with MLS star Tommy Thompson, a football skit with Le’Veon Bell and the Pittsburgh Steelers, and rhythmic gymnastics challenges with Team USA’s Camilla Feeley.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Charity Starts at Home
programme.desc: The Globetrotters visit Bulldog's hometown of Corpus Christi to challenge Little Brothers and Little Sisters to an unforgettable game of basketball and the team trade in their sneaks for cleats.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Trick Shots Ep. 5
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Play It Forward - From Bullied to Brave
programme.desc: Globetrotters TNT, Torch, Wham, and Hammer shed light on the "Art in the Paint" initiative, which helps create artful basketball courts in communities that need them the most. Cheese, Bulldog, Hot Shot, and Jet meet with local D.C. youth to support their mission for clean water and self-reliance.; A young man's life is changed forever when he overcomes bullying with the encouragement from the team. And Hammer takes his slam dunk to new heights with his skydive trick shot.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Show & Sail
programme.desc: The Globetrotters travel to Chicago to learn about organizations that teach diversity in the sport of sailing; they head to Topeka, Kan. and the history of the Showman.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Trick Shots Ep. 2
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - Chicago 2010
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game, from 2010, was played in Chicago, IL.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Running to Grandma's Place
programme.desc: Bulldog and Wham visit a group of formerly homeless men who have dedicated themselves to daily running and each other. Cheese, Jet, and Hotshot travel to Harlem, New York to help teach local students the value of reading. Hammer and Torch learn about the delicious business of selling Gelato. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Swimming With Whale Sharks
programme.desc: Bulldog, Wham, and TNT join wounded veterans for an extraordinary encounter with whale sharks in Atlanta. Torch and Jet get in the groove as they join a special art education program to remix the Globetrotter theme song. Cheese heads home to the Bronx to revisit his roots. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Red Hot Basketball
programme.desc: The team pays homage to their loyal fans as they go inside the Fifth Quarter; Thunder invites Jet and Bulldog to Red Hot Chili Pepper Flea's Conservatory of Music to discover how he keeps the study of music alive for the kids of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Making the Cut
programme.desc: Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway. Who will make the cut? Meanwhile, Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. And, the Globetrotters pay tribute to their legendary teammate Meadowlark Lemon.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Trick Shots Ep. 4
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Scoring Points for the Community
programme.desc: Cheese and Wham learn about kids on the spectrum at The Ed Asner Family Center; the team surprises coach and mentor Chris "Handles" Franklin by honoring him at his community.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Yes You Can!
programme.desc: Hammer, Bulldog, and TNT travel to Phoenix to help empower and motivate local youth at a renowned afterschool program. Bulldog, Jet, and Hotshot learn about the value of financial literacy while discovering the game of golf. Globetrotter Max 'Hops' Pearce unveils his unique artwork. TNT gets help from Wham in her search for a family dog. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - Providence 2025
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in Providence, RI in 2025.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Classic Precision
programme.desc: Coach Lou and the players help create green space in Southside Chicago.; Torch and Cheese learn about the importance of mentorship for teens in the tech industry.; Wham and Bulldog uplift a group looking to make a fresh start.; Thunder throwbacks to his trick shot gauntlet at an abandoned warehouse.; Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Celebrities Ep. 4
programme.desc: A collection of celebrity interactions with the Harlem Globetrotters including sports columnist Matthew Berry, NBA stars Jason Kidd and Dirk Nowitzki, and rapper Snoop Dogg.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - World Records Ep. 2
programme.desc: A collection of world records broken by the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - St. Louis 2025
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in Enterprise Center in St. Louis, MO.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Welcome Home, Soldier
programme.desc: Coach Lou brings the team to Hill AirForce Base to help add some Globetrotter magic to the Welcome Home Celebration for returning troops. Bulldog, Jet and his daughter discover the secrets of marine conservation at Hampton Beach. And the science behind Torch’s signature trick shot. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: My Rookie Season - My Rookie Season Ep. 2
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies and fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Hope Floats
programme.desc: Torch and Bulldog learn the benefits of Equine therapy at "Shining Hope Farms." Hammer, Torch, Bulldog and Ace travel to Chicago to learn about two organizations that teach diversity in the sport of sailing. Hotshot and Cheese hit the court in LA to challenge some locals to a pickup game.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Globetrotters History Ep. 5
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Worthy of Praise
programme.desc: Coach Lou celebrates one of the best Globetrotters of all time: Geese Ausbie; the team breaks bread with a Los Angeles-based group providing birthday parties to kids experiencing homelessness; Thunder breaks down the science behind a trick shot.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Homecoming
programme.desc: Torch and Jet get in the groove as they join a special art education program to remix the Globetrotters' theme song. Coach Lou joins Hammer, Bulldog, and the team to learn about the history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters from their humble beginnings in Chicago. The Globetrotters help a deserving family win a brand new micro-home.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Good Eats
programme.desc: Cheese, Bulldog, Hot Shot, and Jet meet with local D.C. youth to support their mission for clean water and self-reliance. TNT, Torch, Wham, and Hammer learn about cooking nutritious meals through a healthy competition. Thunder and the Globetrotters perform for a special crowd in Chile and meet with the Chilean Minister of Sports and a deserving group of local children. TNT supports Torch from the sidelines of one of the fastest growing sports for women, flag football.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Breaking Boundaries And World Records
programme.desc: The women of the Harlem Globetrotters. Plus, jaw-dropping trick shots, slick handles, and unstoppable energy from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: My Rookie Season - My Rookie Season Ep. 3
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies while fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Blast Off!
programme.desc: Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. Cheese and TNT visit NASA's Kennedy Space Center to learn how teamwork gets a rocket to the moon and back. And Bulldog shares a tribute to his most important mentor and inspiration: his older brother. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Jumping Back Into Action
programme.desc: Hotshot and X-Over teach basketball to kids with dwarfism at the DAAA Games. The team helps foster care children transitioning into new homes. Wham surprises his cousin with a skydiving experience with a veteran-supporting organization.

programme.title: Play It Forward - New Teammates
programme.desc: Coach Lou joins Hammer, Bulldog, and the team to learn about the history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters from their humble beginnings in Chicago. Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway and the Globetrotters remember some of their favorite places from around the world. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters World Tour - Mobile 2025
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in Mobile, AL in 2025.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Love and Basketball
programme.desc: Hotshot, Torch, and Cheese break bread with a LA based group that provides birthday parties to kids experiencing homelessness. Then the Globetrotters partake in a cooking competition with world-renowned chef, Marcus Samuelson. Moose takes the court in Venice Beach to show us the science behind his behind the back shot. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Assisting the Home Team
programme.desc: Torch surprises her high school girls' basketball team with new equipment; the team visits an organization in Chicago where they meet asylum seekers transitioning into U.S. life; Hammer surprises viral sensation Zeke "The Trick Shot Kid" in Georgia.

programme.title: Play It Forward - A Routine Haircut
programme.desc: Wham, Too Tall and Torch team up with gymnast Nia Dennis to inspire a diverse group of young gymnasts in Pasadena; Speedy invites Thunder and Bulldog to his hometown of Philadelphia to give back to a barber who provides haircuts to the homeless.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Trick Shots Ep. 6
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Play It Forward - On The Waterfront
programme.desc: Bulldog joins Jet and his daughter to discover the secrets of marine conservation at Hampton Beach. Then, TNT alongside Jet and his daughter realize just how precious the simple things are on the shores of Sebago Lake. And Thunder proves his vertical lift is as impressive as ever. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Beat Of Their Own Drum
programme.desc: Harlem Globetrotters come together to make some new world records and to take back some old ones. Then Wham, Thunder, and Hammer head to New Orleans to meet kids that have fallen in line to learn the drumline. And we break down the science behind Cheese's famous Granny shot. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Globetrotting with STEAM
programme.desc: Wham visits his hometown of Stone Mountain, GA, to reconnect with family, friends, and his favorite childhood teacher before inviting her and her class on a field trip to a local animal sanctuary. Hammer, Hotshot, Torch, and Coach Lou visit a youth football league in South LA to learn how coaches are inspiring the community. Plus, Hotshot and Cheese hit the court in LA to challenge some locals to a pickup game.

programme.title: Best of the Harlem Globetrotters - Celebrities Ep. 5
programme.desc: A collection of celebrity interactions with the Harlem Globetrotters including magician John Rotellini, NFL great Franco Harris and gymnast Simone Biles.

programme.title: Play It Forward - The Ambassadors of Goodwill
programme.desc: Cheese and TNT empower inner-city youth who are fighting back against violence. Hammer, Cheese, and TNT trade in the wood-grain for the ice rink in Chicago. Globetrotter Max 'Hops' Pearce unveils his unique artwork. Bulldog, Wham, and TNT join a group of wounded veterans for an extraordinary encounter with whale sharks in Atlanta.

programme.title: Play It Forward - Deep in the Heart

programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

programme.title: Quick Cuts - Mr. Basketball’s Journey: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

programme.title: The Snap Count
programme.desc:
On this week's show, Charlie and Trai break down the noticeable changes being reported at Steelers OTAs under new head coach Mike McCarthy and how they compare to the culture and approach established by longtime coach Mike Tomlin.
The duo also discusses the Steelers' decision to sign edge rusher Nick Herbig to a lucrative extension and what it could mean for the futures of veteran pass rushers T.J. Watt and Alex Highsmith.
Plus, Charlie and Trai examine several key position battles on both sides of the ball, identify players with uncertain roles heading into training camp, and explore how their situations could evolve as the offseason progresses.

programme.title: Bruce Drennan Show
programme.desc:
The Guardians may currently hold first place in the AL Central, but that hasn't stopped Bruce from raising concerns about the club's offensive production. He breaks down several troubling metrics that suggest Cleveland's success may not be sustainable over the long haul. Plus, Bruce takes a look around Major League Baseball, identifying which teams appear to be playoff locks and which clubs still have time to make a serious push during the long grind of the season.
Bruce also shares his thoughts on Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby having his eligibility reinstated and the reports that some college football programs may boycott scheduling the Red Raiders in response to the decision.

Hear from social media sensations like Claire Hogel and Mandy "Bombs" Rinsky, then witness the thrilling shootout competition.

programme.title: The BIGPLAY Detroit Show
programme.desc:
Chris takes the mic solo this week to break down a busy week across the Detroit sports landscape.
He starts with the Detroit Red Wings and the growing speculation surrounding captain Dylan Larkin after reports surfaced suggesting he could be interested in a trade. Chris discusses what it would mean for the franchise, whether there's any fire behind the smoke and how Detroit should handle the situation moving forward.
Chris also looks at the Detroit Tigers, who finally found some life once the calendar flipped to June. After weeks of frustration, are the Tigers turning a corner, or is this just a temporary spark? He also examines Tarik Skubal's injury outlook and whether the reigning Cy Young winner still has a realistic path toward capturing a third straight Cy Young Award.
Plus, Chris reacts to recent comments from Dan Campbell regarding Kerby Joseph's injury and what they could mean for the star safety's future. He also dives into Michigan football, discussing whether Bryce Underwood is truly the quarterback of the future and if he's ready to live up to the massive expectations surrounding his arrival in Ann Arbor.

programme.title: BIGPLAY CLE Show
programme.desc:
The crew shares their early impressions of new Browns defensive end Jared Verse and debates whether it's surprising that more players haven't publicly addressed the departure of franchise cornerstone Myles Garrett. They also discuss whether Verse has the personality and leadership traits to emerge as a more vocal presence in the locker room than Garrett was during his time in Cleveland.
Plus, the guys react to head coach Todd Monken's comments that the Browns have two starting-caliber quarterbacks and examine just how much the team's quarterback play could impact its chances of winning games this season.
Later in the show, Jensen Lewis joins to break down which Guardians players have the best chance to earn American League All-Star selections now that voting is underway. He also previews Cleveland's upcoming series against the New York Yankees after the Guardians took two of three games in the Bronx just one week ago.

programme.title: The Matt Fontana Show
programme.desc:
Amid the ongoing Browns quarterback competition between Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders, Matt continues to make the case that Watson will ultimately open the season as the Week 1 starter, while also arguing that the team’s long-term answer at quarterback will likely come from the 2027 rookie draft class. Matt and Ryan also debate whether the battle between Watson and Sanders has truly been a “fair competition,” or if it ultimately just comes down to who gives the team the best chance to win right now.
In addition, Matt reacts to a potential blockbuster trade scenario floated by NBA writer Zach Pincus that would bring LeBron James back to Cleveland.

Amid the ongoing Browns quarterback competition between Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders, Matt continues to make the case that Watson will ultimately open the season as the Week 1 starter, while also arguing that the team’s long-term answer at quarterback will likely come from the 2027 rookie draft class. Matt and Ryan also debate whether the battle between Watson and Sanders has truly been a “fair competition,” or if it ultimately just comes down to who gives the team the best chance to win right now.
In addition, Matt reacts to a potential blockbuster trade scenario floated by NBA writer Zach Pincus that would bring LeBron James back to Cleveland.

programme.title: BIGPLAY CLE Show
programme.desc:
The crew shares their early impressions of new Browns defensive end Jared Verse and debates whether it's surprising that more players haven't publicly addressed the departure of franchise cornerstone Myles Garrett. They also discuss whether Verse has the personality and leadership traits to emerge as a more vocal presence in the locker room than Garrett was during his time in Cleveland.
Plus, the guys react to head coach Todd Monken's comments that the Browns have two starting-caliber quarterbacks and examine just how much the team's quarterback play could impact its chances of winning games this season.
Later in the show, Jensen Lewis joins to break down which Guardians players have the best chance to earn American League All-Star selections now that voting is underway. He also previews Cleveland's upcoming series against the New York Yankees after the Guardians took two of three games in the Bronx just one week ago.

programme.desc:

Plus, Bruce takes a look around Major League Baseball, identifying which teams appear to be playoff locks and which clubs still have time to make a serious push during the long grind of the season.
Bruce also shares his thoughts on Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby having his eligibility reinstated and the reports that some college football programs may boycott scheduling the Red Raiders in response to the decision.

programme.title: The BIGPLAY Detroit Show
programme.desc:
Chris takes the mic solo this week to break down a busy week across the Detroit sports landscape.
He starts with the Detroit Red Wings and the growing speculation surrounding captain Dylan Larkin after reports surfaced suggesting he could be interested in a trade. Chris discusses what it would mean for the franchise, whether there's any fire behind the smoke and how Detroit should handle the situation moving forward.
Chris also looks at the Detroit Tigers, who finally found some life once the calendar flipped to June. After weeks of frustration, are the Tigers turning a corner, or is this just a temporary spark? He also examines Tarik Skubal's injury outlook and whether the reigning Cy Young winner still has a realistic path toward capturing a third straight Cy Young Award.
Plus, Chris reacts to recent comments from Dan Campbell regarding Kerby Joseph's injury and what they could mean for the star safety's future. He also dives into Michigan football, discussing whether Bryce Underwood is truly the quarterback of the future and if he's ready to live up to the massive expectations surrounding his arrival in Ann Arbor.

programme.title: Gone in 60 Days
programme.desc: Work ramps up on our 1970 Tribute Superbird and just when things couldn’t get more stressful, Mark has taken on a new project - a 1969 GTX owned by non other than Chris Jacobs, host of Overhaulin’. Not only does Chris want the car restored to its former glory, he wants it to be completed in time for SEMA 2017 - only sixty days away!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Mopardy
programme.desc: Stress is high at the shop and things don’t get any better when Mark finds out that Tony from Tony’s Mopar Parts has secretly flown out to check in on the progress of his 1970 Challenger. Knowing that the restoration hasn’t started, Mark does everything in his power to distract Tony while Cousin Dougie races to disassemble his car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - A Buck Shorted
programme.desc: SEMA 2017 is fast approaching and the Graveyard Ghouls are working hard on Chris Jacob’s 1969 GTX and John Buck’s 1971 Challenger with a Hellcrate Hemi. But as pressure begins to mount, Mark questions if he’ll be able to keep his promised - and ultimately - is forced to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Phoenix 'Cuda
programme.desc: The Phoenix Cuda: A legendary Mopar which was incinerated and from the ashes, will be reborn at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - SEMA Has Eyes On A Hellbird
programme.desc: Graveyard Carz returns to conclude the epic builds of Chris Jacob’s 1968 GTX after it suffered a devastating fire, and the first of its kind 1970 Plymouth Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - 68 GTX vs Echo Bomber
programme.desc: New Season, New Carz! With SEMA in their rear-view mirror, the ghouls begin the final assembly of a 1969 Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise. And when help comes up short-handed, Mark enlists what he likes to call his “Echo Bomber.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Pilot Takes Flight
programme.desc: It’s the 100th Episode! Join Mark and Royal and watch the never-before-aired Pilot featuring some of the first Mopar restorations the original ghouls tackled over ten-years ago.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Surveying The Will To Work
programme.desc: It’s a hectic day at the Graveyard. Dave jumps from car to car, installing and assembling what he can, Will struggles to keep focused on one project at a time, and Mark makes progress on his A100 build with the hopes of revealing at SEMA 2018!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - What's Next?
programme.desc: Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard! This time, he brings the ghouls two brand new projects - one of which includes installing a brand-new 392 Crate Hemi in his modern Dodge Truck.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Performance with a Touch of Luxury
programme.desc: The Ghouls say goodbye to the 1970 Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi by taking it out for one last drive. Then it’s all hands on deck to get the beautiful second-generation Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise finished in time for the owner to see it for the first time since his father drove it.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Dissecting a Daytona
programme.desc: With a Plymouth GTX finished, the ghoulz refocus their efforts on the 1969 Dodge Daytona. With the owner wanting a full restoration, Mark and the Ghouls begin the tedious disassembly. Because of the car’s pristine condition, they take extra effort to document and preserve as much as they can.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Exorcize a Demon
programme.desc: The unsung heroes of the body shop begin the restoration on one of the most requested renovations ever: a 1971 Dodge Demon. With several panels needing replacement, Mark and George show the intricate process of grafting an entire front-clip from another vehicle to replace the rusted and damaged original.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Frankenstein's Work
programme.desc: It’s crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Look to the West for B5 Blue
programme.desc: Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark’s A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - A Challenger Reflected
programme.desc: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Mark, Dougie, Allysa, Oh My!
programme.desc: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Shaking the Magic 8-Ball
programme.desc: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Rapping Up the Dash
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Upshift Creek
programme.desc: It’s time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix ‘Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their “pick of the show.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - It's A Duster Buster
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Carbituary: Charger
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Daily Driver Transformation Part 1
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to detail an engine bay, deep clean wheels and tires, paint decontamination, and headlight restoration on a 10 year old daily driver.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Daily Driver Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to restore the finish of a 10-year-old vehicle using a rotary and dual action polisher, protecting with a graphene ceramic coating and also restores the faded plastic trim.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Cobra Replica Kit Car Build
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie are working on a build again, but this time it’s no work truck! They’re diving in head first on a 550 Horsepower Cobra Replica Kit Car!

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Fun With A Gen 1 - Part 1
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have a Gen 1 Camaro in the shop and their work is cut out for them! They’re installing a new sub frame, rack and pinion, brakes, gauges … and that’s just half of the work!

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - More Fun With A Gen 1 - Part 2
programme.desc: The Gen 1 Camaro is back in the shop and the guys still have a lot to do if they want to finish this build!

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - WeatherTech Racing – N.C. Facility
programme.desc: Drivers start your engines! This week, Kevin takes a trip to racing country. We’re giving you a backstage look at WeatherTech’s Porsche Race Team and their North Carolina racing facility.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Dang’ Mustang
programme.desc: The guys install a stiffer suspension on this Mustang to help get it ready for power adders and they toss on a new exhaust to sweeten its sound.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Beat up Blazer
programme.desc: Willie and Kevin freshen up a rough looking Chevy Blazer with paint and a new front fascia. They also fix a starting issue and get it running right again.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Wrangler Ready
programme.desc: The guys take a Jeep from meh, to mean - when they install a new long arm suspension kit to get this Jeep Wrangler Unlimited ready for the trails.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Righteous Rear End
programme.desc: This 2010 Camaro will soon be churning out close to 1000 Horsepower, so Kevin and Willie get it ready to handle that power by installing a new Ford 9 inch, new rear axle shafts, and a new drive shaft.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - 12 Hours and Running
programme.desc: “12hrs. & Running”: Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Hidden Hillclimbers
programme.desc: A cross-country race to lay claim to some of the world’s most sought after works specials.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Peashooter
programme.desc: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Davenport Swap
programme.desc: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - 100 Year Old Harley
programme.desc: “Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley”: Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Motorcycle Crime Story
programme.desc: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - The Century Race
programme.desc: “The Century Race”: Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Doubling Down
programme.desc: A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Orphan Bikes
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Wounded Warrior Project
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Second Time's a Charm
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Vegas Payday
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Biker Lore
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Don't Tell Dale
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Diamond in Dodge City
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: Cafe Racer - Alonzo Bodden

programme.title: Cafe Racer - Britain's 59 Club

programme.title: Cafe Racer - Union Motorcycles

programme.desc: Nick Rutter walks you through step-by-step on how to remove stubborn bug splatter from your vehicle along with tips and techniques for using a waterless wash as well as a clay bar.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 2
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides tips and techniques for restoring dull, faded paint using a forced-rotation dual action polisher along with a graphene 3-in-1 ceramic polish, along with severe scratch and scuff removal.

programme.title: Truck U - Truck U Checklist
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno have a large Truck U checklist. They have to get a Bronco Project running again. Bruno has a racer friend stopping by who needs a hand and Matt shows us the new shop purchase.

programme.title: Truck U - K5 Blazer
programme.desc: Time to get low with a K5 Blazer. Matt and Bruno are going to C-notch the frame and and this 73’ blazer while still using the factory wheels and tires.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Turbo Technology
programme.desc: We look at the technology behind turbochargers and intercoolers as we install some upgrades on a F250 Super Duty.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - A Turn for the Better
programme.desc: Willie and Kevin completely overhaul the steering system of a Chevelle.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Twin Turbo Tuning
programme.desc: Willie and Kevin pull out all of the power on a modified C6 vette.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Probing Situation
programme.desc: The guys get a new diagnostic tool in the shop and find a very challenging test for it.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Adventure Mobile
programme.desc: The team at TheBlock.com asks for help from Kevin and Willie B. to outfit the ultimate road trip truck and raise awareness for a worthy cause.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Daytona Turkey Run
programme.desc: Willie B spends a weekend at one of the biggest car events of the year, where a special project is being built right in the middle of all the madness.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MARTY ROBBINS
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT RODS
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BURIED TREASURE
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - INDY RESCUE
programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKEY
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VANDERBILT
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.desc: One of a kind cars at Amelia Island Caffeine & Octane.

programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane at Ameilia Island have everything from classic to extraterrestrial.
